notes: Implemented means test code exists, not that a particular run passed.
G0 only checks configuration. It does not verify a scene, controller, Azure deployment, or UI.
Planned cases must be implemented and executed before their required release gate can pass.
Missing credentials, GPU, test collection, or reports must never count as a live pass.

cases.title: Reference live configuration is structurally and relationally valid
Customer layout, station IDs, and Korean display name need no validator changes
Unsupported schema version is rejected
Missing required environment ID is rejected
Whitespace-only display name is rejected
Unknown credential property is not silently accepted
An arbitrary scene command is not a configuration field
A position must have exactly three coordinates
Coordinates are not coerced from strings
A Boolean is not accepted as a numeric speed
Zero requested speed is rejected
Negative payload is rejected
Duplicate station IDs are rejected
Inverted workspace bounds are rejected
A station outside the declared workspace is rejected
Workspace boundary coordinates are inclusive
Unknown workflow station reference is rejected
A workflow station must have the expected role
Two workflow stages cannot silently share one station
Unknown execution mode is rejected instead of defaulting to replay
Replay is accepted only as an explicitly specified configuration mode
Negative scene seed is rejected
Unknown workflow properties are rejected
Environment ID is an identifier, not a filesystem path
Unbounded step timeout is rejected
Observation age limit must be positive
Custom template ID syntax can be checked without claiming the plugin exists
Mode must be supplied; no implicit live or replay default
Unknown station code field is rejected
Zero-size workspace axis is rejected
A trailing newline is not part of a valid environment identifier
In-memory NaN position is rejected
In-memory positive infinity bound is rejected
In-memory negative infinity speed is rejected
Valid CLI report explicitly says the runtime is not verified
Invalid geometry returns a structured error and nonzero exit
Missing input file is an explicit input error
Malformed JSON fails instead of falling back to the demo fixture
Duplicate JSON keys fail instead of silently keeping the last value
Nonstandard NaN JSON token is rejected
Overflowing JSON numeric literal is rejected as non-finite
Invalid UTF-8 file produces an input error
A JSON array is not accepted as an environment object
Human-readable success message does not claim runtime readiness
Human-readable invalid input goes to stderr and exits nonzero
A directory passed as input is not treated as a successful empty configuration
WSL development workspace and Git metadata agree
cases.preconditions: Approved WSL-backed workspace; no automatic relocation of app-managed worktrees.
cases.procedure: Check OS, interpreter paths, repository root, branch and lockfile installation inside WSL.
assertions: No Windows Python/Node runtime is used.
The chosen Git workflow resolves the same dedicated worktree.
Missing tools or incompatible metadata are explicit failures.

cases.title: Missing, expired, and wrong-environment approval cannot authorize motion
cases.preconditions: Implemented command validator and approval store.
cases.procedure: Submit the same motion with absent, expired, foreign and valid approval tokens.
assertions: All invalid approvals cause zero bridge invocations.
Valid approval authorizes only its exact scoped operation.

cases.title: Duplicate requests produce exactly one physical command
cases.preconditions: Durable job store and idempotent command dispatch.
cases.procedure: Send concurrent retries with one request ID, then restart the API and retry.
assertions: One command is dispatched.
All callers receive the same job ID.
A reused ID with a different payload is rejected.

cases.title: Stale or foreign-version observations cannot drive a new action
cases.preconditions: Versioned observation contract and controlled clock.
cases.procedure: Submit observations older than 2000 ms and observations from a previous environment revision.
assertions: Reobserve or fail explicitly.
No motion uses the stale frame.
Clock boundary cases are covered.

cases.title: Timeout, cancellation and late completion do not resurrect a terminal job
cases.preconditions: Persisted job state machine.
cases.procedure: Race timeout/cancel against ACK and completion events; replay events after reconnect.
assertions: ACK is not success.
Terminal state is monotonic.
No additional motion is dispatched.

cases.title: Only registered skills within controller limits may execute
cases.preconditions: Trusted robot profile independent of customer JSON.
cases.procedure: Submit unknown skills, out-of-workspace poses, excessive limits and code-like arguments.
assertions: All invalid requests are rejected before dispatch.
Customer limits cannot expand the trusted controller envelope.
No generated code is evaluated.

cases.title: Live, replay, synthetic data and connection status remain visible
cases.preconditions: Web console and fixture API.
cases.procedure: Open live and replay runs, navigate tabs, disconnect the stream and reload.
assertions: Badges match the backend mode on every run view.
Disconnection is visible.
No implicit replay transition.

cases.title: Keyboard-accessible instruction, approval and cancellation flow
cases.preconditions: Accessible controls and implemented API.
cases.procedure: Use keyboard-only Korean input, inspect the approval summary, approve and cancel.
assertions: Controls have labels and visible focus.
No dispatch before approval.
Cancellation result is shown, not a fabricated success.

cases.title: Environment editor validates and versions changes without overwriting an active run
cases.preconditions: Environment Studio and versioned environment store.
cases.procedure: Import invalid JSON, correct it, apply while running and again while stopped.
assertions: Invalid JSON is rejected with field errors.
Active run configuration is unchanged.
Successful apply creates a new revision.

cases.title: API failure and session reconnect never display success or duplicate a task
cases.preconditions: Web console with durable run IDs.
cases.procedure: Inject HTTP errors, lost event stream and authentication expiry during a run.
assertions: Errors are actionable.
Reconnect reloads the same run.
No unrequested retry of physical actions.

cases.title: Reviewed customer plugin works without editing core code; incompatible plugins fail
cases.preconditions: SceneBuilder, ObservationAdapter and SkillProvider interfaces.
cases.procedure: Build a second customer package; register it and then try incompatible API versions and unknown template IDs.
assertions: Core code is unchanged.
Known compatible template loads.
Unknown or incompatible registrations fail explicitly.
JSON is never used as an arbitrary import path.

cases.title: Pinned Isaac Sim actually boots and produces fresh rendered frames
cases.runner: pytest on approved Azure GPU runner
cases.preconditions: Approved GPU/driver/container combination and asset licenses.
cases.procedure: Start from a clean instance, load the reference scene and capture readiness plus frames.
assertions: Frame dimensions and timestamps are valid.
Physics ticks advance.
GPU, driver, image digest and scene version are recorded.
Missing GPU fails this required job.

cases.title: Reference skills change actual robot and object state
cases.preconditions: Live scene and baseline controller.
cases.procedure: Reset a fixed seed, run pick/inspect/place, read poses before and after.
assertions: Target object reaches the configured tray volume.
Completion is backed by simulator state, not text.
Reset reproduces the initial state.

cases.title: Bridge loss and emergency stop fail safely within the simulation
cases.preconditions: Live bridge with independent stop path.
cases.procedure: Disconnect the bridge or issue stop during motion and recover.
assertions: Stop does not wait for LLM response.
No hidden replay success.
Reconnect cannot restart a cancelled command.

cases.title: Entra identity and environment ownership are enforced
cases.runner: pytest in isolated Azure test environment
cases.preconditions: Approved test identities and deployments.
cases.procedure: Call APIs with absent, expired, wrong-audience and other-customer credentials.
assertions: 401/403 with no simulator command for unauthorized calls.
Browser bundle contains no service credentials.
Authorized user accesses only their environment.

cases.title: Actual Foundry execution invokes tools and exposes a correlatable run
cases.preconditions: Verified model and agent API deployment.
cases.procedure: Send a real observation and task to the deployed agent; capture invocation and tool results.
assertions: Actual Azure request/run evidence is present.
No fixture or mock provider is enabled.
Throttling and model errors remain visible.

cases.title: Images, job state and traces preserve one provenance chain
cases.preconditions: Managed identity access to Blob, Cosmos DB and observability.
cases.procedure: Execute one run, reload it after API restart and retrieve its stored observation.
assertions: Image checksum matches the model input evidence.
Environment/model versions and run ID match.
Service authentication uses scoped identity.
Secrets are excluded from logs.

cases.title: Browser instruction drives real Foundry and physical sorting
cases.preconditions: G3 and G4 verified on the same release candidate.
cases.procedure: Run the Korean inspect-and-quarantine instruction over 20 fixed normal/defect episodes.
assertions: At least 18 of 20 episodes satisfy the physical success predicate.
Each run has a real model call and state change.
30-second deadline failures are reported rather than hidden.

cases.title: Second customer environment completes the same live workflow without core edits
cases.preconditions: Reviewed customer extension and its custom layout.
cases.procedure: Import the second environment, apply its version and run inspection/sorting.
assertions: Custom asset and station positions appear in the actual simulator.
Correct customer trays receive objects.
Reference environment runs and records are unaffected.

cases.title: Training and evaluation data are valid and disjoint
cases.preconditions: Recorded simulator demonstrations and LeRobot conversion.
cases.procedure: Validate dimensions, time order, episode boundaries and train/eval manifests; inject duplicates and empty data.
assertions: Invalid or empty datasets fail.
No overlapping episode IDs/seeds in configured splits.
Checksums and generation provenance are preserved.

cases.title: Azure ML policy training yields a versioned checkpoint and held-out simulator evaluation
cases.runner: Azure ML job plus pytest evaluator
cases.preconditions: Approved training compute and validated data.
cases.procedure: Train a small policy, register its checkpoint and evaluate against the baseline on held-out episodes.
assertions: A real job produces the checkpoint.
Training and evaluation IDs are linked.
Raw episode results and baseline comparison are available.
No claim that all training completes during a 20-minute demo.

cases.title: Visual inspection quality is measured without leaking simulator labels to the model
cases.preconditions: At least 40 held-out normal/defect examples.
cases.procedure: Inspect captured images, compare predictions with evaluator-only truth and export a confusion matrix.
assertions: Recall at least 90% and false reject rate at most 10% on the frozen reference set.
Model input excludes ground-truth labels.
Raw failures and uncertainty are retained.

cases.title: Fault injection, telemetry and inspection use the same asset and environment revision
cases.preconditions: Implemented bounded fault injection and telemetry adapter.
cases.procedure: Inject a declared defect or equipment anomaly and reset the scenario.
assertions: Events carry the same asset/version IDs.
Reset removes the fault.
Threshold detection is not labeled as a validated predictive model.

cases.title: IaC validates and deploys the approved app and GPU profiles reproducibly
cases.runner: Bicep validation plus isolated azd deployment test
cases.preconditions: Selected subscription, region, quota, identity and budget.
cases.procedure: Compile/validate IaC, inspect proposed resources, deploy and run readiness checks.
assertions: No arbitrary default subscription selection.
Deployment parameters and image/model versions are recorded.
Readiness tests verify actual endpoints.

cases.title: Cleanup and timeout affect only explicitly recorded test resources
cases.preconditions: Disposable resource group and a separate sentinel resource.
cases.procedure: Trigger normal cleanup and timeout cleanup; list the recorded resource IDs afterwards.
assertions: Owned test resources are removed or explicitly reported as retained.
Sentinel and unrelated resources are untouched.
Residual GPU/disk charges are not called zero cost.

cases.title: Release gate rejects missing, skipped, stale or zero-test live evidence
cases.preconditions: Implemented strict release evidence aggregator.
cases.procedure: Feed reports with missing credentials, no GPU, skipped cases, zero collection, missing required IDs and wrong commit IDs.
assertions: Every incomplete required gate fails release.
Planned cases cannot count as passes.
Only complete current-candidate evidence can pass.
